attributes.text: Grab the screen from anywhere, crop it, and share it. Nothing is saved to your device → nothing to clean up.
attributes.originalText: Grab the screen from anywhere, crop it, and share it. Nothing is saved to your device → nothing to clean up.

attributes.text: Choose Circle to Share as the digital assistant app (Default digital assistant app > Circle to Share). This makes the assistant gesture open the crop overlay (e.g., press and hold the power button, or swipe up from a bottom corner). If a "Use screen data" toggle is shown there, enable it.

attributes.description: Show how: Set as your assistant

attributes.text: If your device doesn't hand screenshots to third-party assistants, the accessibility service captures the screen instead. Under Accessibility > Circle to Share, turn on the main "Use" toggle. (This also powers the Quick Settings tile and the floating button, both under "How to open it".)
